output_unit.description: Unit for memory reporting. Valid values: 'k' (kilobytes), 'm' (megabytes), 'g' (gigabytes).

interval.description: Delay in seconds between updates. 0 for single snapshot.

count.description: Number of times to repeat output. 0 for indefinite.

process_filter.description: Comma-separated list of PIDs or process names to monitor.

top_consumers.description: Enable top mode for top consumers of memory.

top_changes.description: Enable top mode for top changes in memory.

use_comm_field.description: Use process comm field for command info.
